title: Financial Management Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) PMOS, DC P&R
raw_text:
2.     MOS 3404, Financial Management Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) PMOS, DC P&R

    a. Summary. Financial Management Officers formulate and supervise the
execution of policies and procedures pertaining to the financial management
of appropriated funds in the operating forces and supporting activities. The
functional areas of assignment are budget formulation and execution, finance,
and resource evaluation and analysis. Budget formulation and execution
duties include supervising the operations of a budget office or section,
providing guidance for formulation of budgets, compiling budget estimates,
and reviewing and monitoring budget performance and execution. Finance
duties include supervising the operations of a finance office or section
within a finance office, providing guidance procedures, ascertaining the
validity of disbursements and the collection of public funds, and supervising
and directing the legal expenditure of public funds. Resource evaluation and
analysis functions may include the evaluation and analysis of resource
management issues and problems, workstation inspections, and external audits
liaison.

        (1) Budget formulation and execution duties include supervising the
operations of a budget office or section, providing guidance for formulation
of budgets, compiling budget estimates, and reviewing and monitoring budget
performance and execution.

        (2) Finance duties include supervising the operations of a finance
office or section within a finance office, providing guidance procedures,
ascertaining the validity of disbursements and the collection of public
funds, and supervising and directing the legal expenditure of public funds.

        (3) Resource evaluation and analysis functions may include the
evaluation and analysis of resource management issues and problems,
workstation inspections, and external audits liaison.

       b.   Prerequisites.   None.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Financial Management Officer Course (M03FNH0), MCB
Camp Lejeune, NC.

        (2) Completion of USMC Advanced Financial Management Officer Course
(M03FNM0) Camp Lejeune, NC (highly recommended for Capt and above).



                                         1-196                      Enclosure (1)
 1124                                                                  NAVMC 1200.1L



        (3) Complete and maintain the appropriate level DoD FM Certification
in accordance with DoDI 1300.26 and amplifying Marine Corps guidance.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (w), Financial Management (FM) Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Financial Managers 11-3031.

       f.   Related Military Skill.     None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
